name: number-flow-trading
title: Live Price Ticker
blurb: Live price ticker with animated number flow and directional arrow indicator.
description: Trading-style price display showing a USD-formatted price with an up/down diff percentage. Numbers animate smoothly via NumberFlow library. Arrow icon rotates 180° when diff is negative. Includes a shuffle button cycling through hardcoded…
use_when: Stock tickers, price displays, or financial dashboards needing smooth number animations.
avoid_when: Real-time price updates (no props for live data binding); hardcoded demo prices only.
a11y: Price and diff are readable numbers (NumberFlow renders text to DOM). Arrow is decorative. Shuffle button is keyboard-accessible.
